roofing-financing-ambient.purpose: A quiet pause to understand the roof scope before comparing payment terms.

roofing-financing-scroll.purpose: Understand the roof estimate, compare terms and decide on the next step without suggesting approval.

beats.title: Start with the project.
beats.body: Ask for a written roof scope before choosing how to pay.

beats.title: Compare the available paths.
beats.body: Consider your own budget and any options the contractor has confirmed.

beats.title: Read the total cost and terms.
beats.body: Look at the APR, repayment term and total alongside the payment.

beats.title: Apply with the lender, if you choose.
beats.body: Use the contractor’s confirmed lender link when you are ready.

beats.title: Confirm your next step.
beats.body: Discuss the roof work and timing before making a commitment.

roofing-promotions-ambient.purpose: Consider how roof work can fit around everyday life, without implying an available offer.

beats.title: A home still in use.
beats.body: Roof details in quiet afternoon light.

beats.title: Room for the work.
beats.body: Light reveals the roof edge and material texture.

beats.title: Back to your day.
beats.body: A soft branch shadow returns to the opening composition.

roofing-promotions-scroll.purpose: Bring an entered offer into a clear written roofing estimate, without implying an offer exists.

beats.title: Bring the exact offer.
beats.body: If you saved an offer, bring its name or code so you and the contractor are discussing the same thing.

beats.title: Match it to the roof work.
beats.body: Ask which part of the proposed repair or replacement it can apply to.

beats.title: Ask for the revised estimate.
beats.body: Have the contractor show how the offer affects the quoted work and total, rather than leaving you to work it out.

beats.title: Keep one agreed version.
beats.body: Before moving ahead, keep the estimate that reflects the scope and any offer the contractor has confirmed.
